_comment: UBI-175 Phase 6: one entry per golden page. verify_against_golden.py regenerates each entry from these exact params and diffs against golden/<provider>/<slug>.mdx. schema_dir/idents_path point at real, reproducible ubx sdk gen / extract_idents.py output -- see README.md for how to regenerate them fresh. Candidates below are UNCOMMITTED pending hand review (see this session's report) -- do not treat as an accepted reference until a human has reviewed the real generated content and this file (or an --accept run) is committed.

candidates.why_chosen: Category override (EC2), deep nesting (max depth 5, LaunchTemplateData), 61 AI-inferred fields, real cross-reference to aws_launch_configuration in its own intro. No existing live page for this resource (net-new to the CFN registry) -- a fresh generation, not an overwrite.
candidates.bindings_status_note: UBI-175 Step 2 re-review: this was originally published, on the theory that the real ubx-sdk-aws repo covers this resource. A real scan_go/scan_py/scan_ts pass against the actual cloned repo (not name matching) found ubx-sdk-aws is the pre-existing HashiCorp-sourced corpus (the same one moved to resource-reference/aws-hashicorp/ in Step 1), not a CFN one -- aws_launch_template only APPEARED covered because it happens to be one of 408/1709 wires where the CFN name and a Terraform resource name coincide, which proves nothing about matching fields (the same trap already found for GCP's own 175/656 name-only overlap). Corrected to local_only, matching the real, uniform bindings_status the actual 1709-page corpus was generated with -- verified byte-identical against resource-reference/aws/launch/template.mdx after regeneration.

candidates.why_chosen: Category override (Dedicated Host), real nesting (depth 4) via InstanceView, 8 AI-inferred fields, real cross-reference to azure_dedicated_host_group (same 19-resource ARM-Compute corpus). bindings_status=local_only: no ubx-sdk-azure-compute repo published (schema_name 'azure' is a distinct, newer real identity from 'azurerm', see REAL_SDK_REPO_ID's own doc comment).

Real depth (5) and 92 AI-inferred fields -- the richest, most representative Datadog resource in the current 26-resource corpus. Honest gap: NOT one of Datadog's only 2 real category-override candidates (datadog_shared_dashboard, datadog_user_response), both of which are shallow (depth 1) and were judged too thin/convenient a pick to represent real complexity -- category-override coverage for this provider is not exercised by this candidate. Cross-reference is real but implicit (matching_downtimes/restricted_roles fields reference other real Datadog resources by relationship, not a named backtick reference in the intro prose).

Category override (Repositories), the deepest real complexity in this candidate set: 111 top-level fields, depth 3, 428 AI-inferred fields, and its own intro explicitly says it is 'the base unit almost every other GitHub resource in this reference is scoped underneath' -- a real, load-bearing cross-reference, not a token one.

Deep nesting (depth 8) and heavy AI-inferred content (71 fields) -- itself a real, live example of the region_*/zone_* parent-concept sourcing pattern that accounts for nearly all of GCP's parent-concept intros, with a real (if not backtick-literal) cross-reference to its own zonal counterpart google_compute_instance_group_manager. Honest gap: zero category-override candidates exist anywhere within GCP's current 95-resource compute-only scope (verified directly against categories.json's own overrides dict intersected with the compute schema dump) -- this property cannot be exercised for GCP at all right now, not a selection oversight.

The deepest real nesting in this entire candidate set (depth 9, 1035 AI-inferred fields) and a real, named cross-reference in its own intro ('the mechanism a Deployment actually manages underneath'). Also the one candidate that live-triggered the real cycle-detection guard in render_response_field (a genuine self-referential PodSpec), proving that code path against real data, not just a synthetic test. Honest gap: zero category-override candidates exist anywhere in Kubernetes's real categories.json (confirmed: its own overrides dict is empty). bindings_status=local_only: the published ubx-sdk-kubernetes-* repos are stale relative to the current live schema and do not contain a ReplicaSet binding at all under any name (a real, separately-notable finding, not this candidate's own defect) -- idents extracted fresh via local `ubx sdk gen` instead.
